security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Static security scanner for PHP applications
bundle.longDescription: PHP Scanner finds injection vulnerabilities, web shells, leaked secrets and vulnerable PHP runtimes (including php2shell CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) in PHP codebases.
